objective: locate the stage(s) at which SFT improves or regresses

inference.method: paired cluster bootstrap over semantic group_id
inference.difference: SFT minus base, in percentage points

power.note: a 'supported' Kill@8 claim needs the lower 95% bound >= +3 points; at the observed effect that requires the multiplier above on independent clusters, assuming the effect is real and SE scales as 1/sqrt(clusters)

H5.why: parse +0.15, policy +0.00, execute|parse +1.26 points: no contract stage falls by more than 1 point. The form DID change, toward exact-equality oracles (0.725 -> 0.995 of policy-valid candidates), i.e. stronger, not degraded, tests

H2.why: P(disc|execute) +4.37 points, CI [1.9382, 6.9406]. The frozen signature (P(correct oracle|disc) falls) holds unstratified: -13.85, CI [-22.5204, -4.7957]. Stratified by assertion form (added after the first look), exact-value accuracy on discriminating inputs moves -4.25, CI [-11.0905, 2.6711]: SFT neither measurably damaged nor improved value prediction (an improvement of >= 5 points is excluded). Imitation transferred assertion form and input choice, not the value. Causal support needs a Phase 4 single-factor arm

H7.why: Kill@8 +3.43 points, clustered CI [-4.0303, 10.8757] over 78 semantic clusters; minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 10.681 points

H6.why: frozen signature: the conditional oracle rate declines WITH STEPS. Step 431 vs step 100 on ablation_dev: unstratified +0.22 [-7.1181, 6.884], equality-stratified +2.59 [-3.4409, 8.288]. Versus step 0 the unstratified rate drops by step 100 and then plateaus (50: -2.9, 100: -13.3, 150: -15.3, 200: -15.3, 250: -16.0, 300: -15.5, 350: -14.6, 400: -14.2, 431: -13.1), tracking the equality-form share (50: 0.77, 100: 0.94, 150: 0.98, 200: 0.99, 250: 1.00, 300: 1.00, 350: 1.00, 400: 1.00, 431: 1.00)

H1.why: not identifiable from retained outputs; needs a Phase 3 probe

H3.why: not identifiable from retained outputs; needs a Phase 3 probe

H4.why: not identifiable from retained outputs; needs a Phase 3 probe

post_hoc_additions.status: exploratory refinement added after the first Phase 2 look; reported alongside, never instead of, the frozen unstratified mediator

why_superseded: its H6 rule tested 'below step 0 at every step >= 100', not the frozen signature 'declines with steps'; the data show a drop by step 100 and then a plateau, which the frozen signature treats as weakening
it lacked form-stratified oracle accuracy: SFT moved ~99.5% of assertions to exact equality, so the unstratified conditional oracle rate mixes value prediction with assertion form
